capability.title: Menu Catalog
capability.description: Filterable, sortable menu catalog with category tabs, dietary filter toggles, a sort control, and dish cards showing photo, badges, description, and price.
useWhen: A menu page should let visitors focus on one category at a time
Visitors should filter dishes by dietary badges and sort by price or name
avoidWhen: Only a small fixed selection of dishes is shown without browsing controls
The dishes carry no category or dietary badge data
